text:
jamal: creating RC for embed-service fix (crash on large-batch assemble). need quick QA + infra thumbs. aiming for staged prod push over 45m window.

deploy-bot: Candidate created: rc-2026-03-21-119. Artifact: embed-service@2.0.1-crashfix. Use `/promote` to advance.

lina: ran unit + integration subset on staging, crash reproduction gone. added a short-lived feature-flag to gate the new assembler.

sam: ops note: memory bump on pod template to 6Gi for canary so we don't OOM under batch loads. will apply after pin.

jamal: good. propose staged percentages: 2% -> 10% -> 40% -> 100%. failure gates: OOM or container restarts > 0.5% OR error-rate spike > 2x baseline for 3m.

ops-bert: Saved rollout policy: steps=[2,10,40,100], step_delay=12m, auto-rollback=true. Pin target clusters: us-west-1-primary, eu-central-fallback.

lina: release-notes snippet ready: "fix: prevent assembler crash when processing >50k tokens in a single batch; adds defensive checks and flag to throttle oversized batches"

jamal: QA smoke commands: ```kubectl -n staging exec -it svc-embed -- ./scripts/run-batch-test.sh 50000``` results: "OK, 0 crashes"

sam: infra change applied (memory template), canary podcount=6 for 2% -> matches traffic model.

jamal: giving initial signoff to start canary. lina, you good to watch logs and alerts?

lina: watching. setting a log query for "assembler: panic" and container_restart count. will post if anything.

deploy-bot: Promotion initiated by jamal. Stage=canary (2%). UI: https://deploys.redwood/rc-2026-03-21-119

ops-bert: 12m check: canary pods stable, container_restarts=0, OOMs=0. latency p95 unchanged.

lina: log query clear. no new assembler panics, CPU spike minimal. proceed to 10%.

deploy-bot: Rolled to 10% (after 12m). Current metrics: restarts=0, error-rate=0.15% (<baseline 0.2%).

sam: pushing to 40% in 12m unless we see restarts. alert thresholds still active.

jamal: reminder: if any crash appears, run `/rollback rc-2026-03-21-119 --immediate` and notify oncall.

lina: 40% step started. spike in memory on one node but no restarts; adding pod anti-affinity to avoid packing.

deploy-bot: Rolled to 40% (step_delay satisfied). Metrics: one node mem spike, no OOM, error-rate stable.

ops-bert: adjusted affinity, spun new pods, draining the noisy node. no user-facing impact.

jamal: proceeding to full roll. command: `/promote rc-2026-03-21-119 --to prod`

deploy-bot: Promotion to prod in progress: will ramp to 100% over 20m. Final artifact pinned: embed-service@2.0.1-crashfix -> us-west-1-primary, eu-central. Release notes: https://docs.redwood/releases/2026-03-21-embed-rc119

lina: post-roll sanity: smoke tests passed, curated evaluation set ok.

sam: :rocket: tagging changelog and emailing product for release blurb.

jamal: closing thread. great job everyone.
